theorems.name: Submission.dph_lpf_linearity
theorems.statement: (∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ) (F : Set (Eucl m)), 0 < r → IsClosed F → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening r F) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → ∃ Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m', (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) ∧ (∀ n, ∀ x ∈ thickening (r / 2) F, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ Λ) ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop (thickening (r / 2) F) ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (Gj n ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → (∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (X X₁ X₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ) (S S₁ S₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (a a₁ : ℝ), 0 < r → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening r (X.support ∪ X₁.support)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ (X.support ∪ X₁.support))) → (∀ ω, X₂ ω = a * X ω + a₁ * X₁ ω) → (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X₁.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X₁.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X₁ (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S₁ ω))) → (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X₂.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X₂.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X₂ (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S₂ ω))) → ∀ ω, S₂ ω = a * S ω + a₁ * S₁ ω)
